description: This file is part of Google Mock, implementing the spec builder syntax (ON_CALL and EXPECT_CALL) for mocking in C++. It defines classes, methods, and functions related to setting expectations, managing mock objects, and handling mock behaviors.

classes.name: ExpectationBase
classes.description: Base class for expectations, managing call counts, prerequisites, and expectation properties.

classes.name: Expectation
classes.description: Wrapper class for expectation base objects, managing expectations on mock functions.

classes.name: Sequence
classes.description: Represents a sequence of expectations, allowing ordering of mock calls.

classes.name: InSequence
classes.description: Manages an implicit sequence for ordering expectations within a scope.

classes.name: MockObjectState
classes.description: Tracks the state of a mock object, including usage location and leakability.

classes.name: MockObjectRegistry
classes.description: Global registry tracking all active mock objects and their states.

classes.name: UntypedFunctionMockerBase
classes.description: Base class for mock function objects, handling registration, invocation, and expectation management.

methods.name: SpecifyCardinality
methods.description: Sets the expected number of calls for an expectation.

methods.name: AllPrerequisitesAreSatisfied
methods.description: Checks if all prerequisites for an expectation are satisfied.

methods.name: DescribeCallCountTo
methods.description: Describes the call count status of an expectation.

methods.name: CheckActionCountIfNotDone
methods.description: Checks if the number of actions matches the expectation.

methods.name: UntypedTimes
methods.description: Sets the expectation for the number of times a function should be called.

methods.name: ReportUninterestingCall
methods.description: Reports uninteresting calls based on the reaction setting.

methods.name: RegisterOwner
methods.description: Registers the owner mock object for a mock method.

methods.name: SetOwnerAndName
methods.description: Sets the owner mock object and name for a mock method.

methods.name: MockObject
methods.description: Returns the mock object associated with a mock method.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the mock method.

methods.name: UntypedInvokeWith
methods.description: Invokes the mock method with given arguments, handling expectations and reporting.

methods.name: GetHandleOf
methods.description: Returns an expectation handle referencing a specific expectation.

methods.name: VerifyAndClearExpectationsLocked
methods.description: Verifies and clears expectations on a mock function.
